steps.title: Configure TessBaseAPI Asset Copying with Fallback
steps.description: Updated initTesseractIfNeeded to check asset paths tessdata/eng.traineddata and eng.traineddata before copying to tesseract/tessdata directory.

steps.title: Initialize Native TessBaseAPI Engine
steps.description: Instantiated com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI directly and called init() with parent directory path and eng language.

steps.title: Update processBitmapUnified for High Quality Text Extraction
steps.description: Passed processed bitmap to TessBaseAPI.setImage() and extracted raw text via getUTF8Text().

steps.title: Parse Printed Product Attributes and Store Raw Text
steps.description: Sent UTF-8 raw text to parsePrintedProductInfo and updated ProductScannerResult rawOcrText.

steps.title: Refine IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 Luhn Extraction Rules
steps.description: Enforced 15-digit Luhn checksum verification and digit correction for extracted IMEI candidates.

steps.title: Enhance Hardware Attributes and Label Parsers
steps.description: Expanded pattern matchers for Brand, Model, Color, RAM, Storage, and Serial Number identifiers.

steps.title: Update MainActivity Product Form Autofill
steps.description: Auto-filled description field and displayed Toast notification showing raw OCR text snippet while preserving ZXing barcode decoding.

steps.title: Verify Non-Blocking Frame Processing
steps.description: Ensured live preview frame decoding runs seamlessly on secondary threads.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Language Restrictions
steps.description: Validated code structure using standard Java 8 syntax and anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile final APK with functioning offline Tesseract OCR text extraction and ZXing barcode scanning.
